intro.title: You are here. You are safe enough.
intro.body: Let’s bring your attention back to the present, one sense at a time. It takes about two minutes.
intro.note: There are no right answers. Approximate is perfectly fine, and you never need to repeat a step.

sense.hint: Take your time. Tap when you have noticed them.
sense.settled: Lovely. Stay here for a moment.

done.title: You’re back in the present.
done.body: Thoughts may still be around, and that’s okay. You don’t have to push them away or solve them. Carry on with what matters to you.
done.note: If it feels overwhelming, consider reaching out to a therapist or someone you trust.

see.prompt: Look around slowly. Find things you can see.
see.examples: a mug, a shadow, a blue book, your shoe

touch.prompt: Notice what your body feels right now.
touch.examples: your jeans, a cool desk, feet on the floor

hear.prompt: Listen closely. Let the sounds come to you.
hear.examples: a humming fridge, birds, your own breathing

smell.prompt: Breathe in gently. Notice any scent.
smell.examples: coffee, soap, old paper, a piece of clothing

taste.prompt: Notice any taste in your mouth, or take a sip of water.
